description: An ICU4C library for MSVC projects.
releaseNotes:
Package Notes:

 * This package was build from the allinone.sln solution in ICU4C, patched as described below
 * The solution file was patched to compile with C++20, which makes char8_t methods available
 * The solution is configured to reference the multi-threaded DLL CRT in the appropriate configurations

See the ICU release notes about ICU changes.
https://github.com/unicode-org/icu/releases/tag/release-78.1
